held_in.text: a security held directly in a securities account at a bank or a TASE member: a tradable series is bought on TASE on any trading day, and sales to the public in the issue auctions go through banks and TASE members (GOV-21, GOV-10, GOV-17, BRK-01). A self-directed provident or study fund may hold it too (IRA-11), and there that wrapper's tax applies instead of this record's. Who may open the account, who supervises it and how client securities are kept are the account's (brokerage-account).

regulator.notes: The issuer is the State of Israel through the Accountant General's Government Debt Management Unit (GOV-10). Trading on TASE is under the ISA's supervision of the exchange (Securities Law ss.45, 51; REG-13). The securities account that holds the bonds has its own supervisor (brokerage-account). The site's copy has no name for the Finance Ministry as an issuer, so the regulator shown is the one over the market.

labels: accrued interest paid when buying between coupon dates is not modelled (TXI OQ5, G-10)

lawful_exit.text: Any trading day: a tradable series can be sold on TASE at the market price of the day (GOV-17). Held to maturity, the state redeems the face value in one payment, indexed for a CPI-linked series (GOV-11, GOV-15). An early redemption by the state is its option, by buyback at market price (GOV-16). The settlement cycle for a secondary sale was not readable (GOV open question 7), so no payout-days figure is recorded.

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Selling one series to buy another is a sale (s.88 "מכירה"): an unlinked series pays up to 15% on the whole gain (TXI-12), a CPI-linked series up to 25% on the real gain (TXI-14), withheld by the bank or member (TXS-05).

eligibility.text: whoever holds a securities account (held_in), buying a tradable series on TASE on any trading day (GOV-17), with a minimum order of NIS 10,000 in continuous trading (GOV-24); the bank's fee types for the trade follow its tariff (BRK-16). Sales to the public in the weekly auctions go by law through banks, TASE members and other approved bodies (GOV-10), but how a retail order reaches an auction, with what minimum and fee, was not found (GOV open question 8). The issue unit is NIS 1,000 face value (GOV-11, GOV-15). Designated series (ערד, ח"ץ) are issued only to pension funds and insurers (GOV-18)

protection.text: principal and coupons are paid from the state's general revenues, an obligation of the state and not of the bank or broker (GOV-02). A CPI-linked series has no floor in the regulation text: if the index falls below the base index, principal and coupon are reduced (GOV-12; per-series floors unverified, GOV open question 6). A state buyback before maturity is at market price and the state's option (GOV-16). How the account keeps the bonds, and what happens if the bank or member fails, is the account's (brokerage-account)
